models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Guest user identity and profile information for the todoApp system.

Stores unauthenticated user records who may access limited system features before full registration or authentication. Each guest is represented by a unique identifier string that can be used to track their interactions or sessions during their transient usage period.

Guests have creation and update timestamps for auditing, and soft deletion support to allow removal without permanent data loss. Guest records serve as a foundation for managing temporary or transient users separately from registered authenticated users.

This table has a primary key UUID "id" and includes a unique guest identifier string. It is functionally independent from user-related tables handled in other components but may relate indirectly through session tables already defined separately.

plainFields.name: guest_identifier
plainFields.description: Unique string identifier for the guest user, used to track transient users prior to registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when the guest record was deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Guest user authentication sessions tracking login states and connection metadata.

Each session belongs to a single guest user and records information about the connection such as IP address, URL accessed (href), and referrer URL. Sessions are append-only with timestamps marking creation and expiration for lifecycle management.

This table supports auditing of guest login activity and helps maintain system security and session validity. It references {@link todo_app_guests.id} to link the session to the guest identity.

The model is architected as an actor session entity with standalone lifecycle, appropriate for managing ephemeral guest session data.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest user. {@link todo_app_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest session connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed during the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions must have expiration for security.

models.name: todo_app_access_tokens
models.description:
JWT access tokens issued to users or guests for authentication and authorization.

This table stores the active and historical access tokens, including token string, type, and timestamps indicating issuance, expiry, and revocation.

Foreign keys link tokens to either registered users or guest users, supporting multiple token types for flexible authentication mechanisms.

Used in security workflows to validate user sessions and authorize API requests. Tokens can be revoked and tracked for security audits.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the registered user who owns this token. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest user who owns this token. {@link todo_app_guests.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user session during which this token was issued. {@link todo_app_user_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: JWT access token string used for authenticating requests.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of the token, e.g., 'access', 'api', or 'refresh'.

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was issued.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token expires.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was revoked, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_refresh_tokens
models.description:
Refresh tokens issued to authenticated users for secure session renewal and longevity.

This table manages JWT refresh tokens linked to specific users and their authenticated sessions. It stores the token string, creation timestamp, and expiration timestamp to enforce valid session duration policies.

Each refresh token directly references a user and the session it originated from, enabling secure token revocation and audit capabilities. This design supports efficient lookup and management of active and expired tokens in the authentication subsystem.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key identifying the refresh token record uniquely.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user associated with this refresh token. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_session_id
foreignFields.description: The user session that this refresh token is linked to. {@link todo_app_user_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token string used to obtain new access tokens.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refresh token was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refresh token expires, enforcing session validity duration.

models.name: todo_app_configurations
models.description:
Global application configuration settings accessible system-wide.

This table stores key-value pairs representing various configuration parameters used throughout the todoApp system. Each configuration entry includes a unique key, a value stored as a string, and the data type of the value for proper interpretation.

Configuration entries can be independently created, updated, and deleted by authorized system components or administrators.
Soft deletion is supported via the deleted_at timestamp to maintain historical context and enable recovery.

Timestamps created_at and updated_at provide audit trails for changes in configuration settings.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key UUID for configuration entry.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifying the setting.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as a string; interpretation depends on the type field.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Data type of the configuration value (e.g., string, int, boolean) for parsing and validation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable description explaining the purpose of this configuration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null means the configuration is active.

models.name: todo_app_security_policies
models.description:
System security policies and feature flags controlling application behavior.

Stores key-value pairs representing various security and feature toggles used to configure system behavior dynamically. Each policy has a descriptive text explaining its purpose.

Supports soft deletion for safe policy deactivation without permanent data loss. Active flag indicates whether the policy is currently enforced.

This table serves as a central configuration point for security settings enforceable across the entire todo app system.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the security policy or feature flag.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value of the security policy, representing its configuration state or setting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed explanation of the policy's purpose and usage.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the policy is currently active and enforced.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the policy was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the policy was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark the policy as logically deleted without removing it from the database.

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Records verifying tokens and verification status for user emails.

This table stores email verification tokens generated for users during registration or email change processes. It tracks the token string and its expiration time, as well as when the verification was completed. The table is associated with the authenticated user through a foreign key relationship with the users table.

Temporal fields include created_at for token creation and deleted_at for soft deletion support. The token field is unique to ensure no token duplication.

This model supports secure email verification workflows critical to user authentication and account integrity.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user this verification belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to the user email.

plainFields.name: token_expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the verification token.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when the email verification was completed. Null if not verified yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was soft deleted.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset requests made by users to regain access to their accounts.

This table stores the reset tokens, expiration times, and request timestamps associated with each password reset attempt. It references the user who initiated the reset request ensuring audit trails and secure management of password recovery flows.

Soft deletion is supported to allow historical record keeping while enabling administrative cleanup or invalidation of password reset requests.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who requested the password reset. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token generated for the password reset process. Used to authenticate the reset attempt.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration date and time of the password reset token. After this, the token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to mark the password reset request as deleted without removing data.

models.name: todo_app_roles
models.description:
Application roles defining permissions and access levels within the system.

Each role represents a set of permissions that can be assigned to users to control access to various application features and resources.

Roles are managed independently and support standard lifecycle operations including creation, update, and soft deletion.

This table serves as the foundation for role-based access control within the todoApp application.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the role used for identification and assignment.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the role's purpose and the permissions it grants.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_user_roles
models.description:
Mapping table linking users to roles, supporting a many-to-many relationship between the two entities.

This table enables assigning multiple roles to a single user and allows each role to be assigned to multiple users independently.

Each record associates one user with one role, ensuring unique assignments via a composite unique constraint on user and role IDs.

As a subsidiary entity, this table is managed through its parent entities, mainly users and roles, and supports authorization and access control in the system.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_role_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the role assigned to the user. {@link todo_app_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Registered users with authentication credentials and profile data.

This table stores all essential information about users who can log into the system. It includes unique identifiers, authentication credentials such as email and password hash, and operational timestamps for auditing and lifecycle management.

Users have unique email addresses and usernames to ensure distinct identity across the platform. Passwords are stored as hashes to maintain security.

Soft deletion is supported to allow account deactivation without data loss. The table serves as the basis for user authentication and authorization, and has relational connections to session and roles tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address used for login and communication.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique username chosen by the user for identification within the app.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for user authentication. Plain passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion of the user account, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for registered users tracking login state and session details.

This table stores a record of each login session initiated by a user in the system. Sessions include connection context information such as IP address, access URL (href), and referrer URL to help with security auditing and anomaly detection.

Each session is tied to exactly one user via the foreign key relationship to todo_app_users.id. Sessions have a definitive expiration time to enforce security policies and session lifecycle management.

This table uses a session stance as it exists solely to maintain login session lifecycle data and is managed through authentication flows rather than standard CRUD operations.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: References the user who owns this authentication session. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page or resource accessed during the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page leading to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: todo_app_todo_items
models.description:
Todo items owned exclusively by individual users.

Each todo item belongs to a registered user represented by the todo_app_users table. Users manage their todo items independently with full CRUD operations. The table tracks title, description, and status to represent the task's content and lifecycle state.

Soft deletion is enabled to support audit trails and recovery of deleted tasks. Temporal fields created_at and updated_at maintain the creation and modification history. This model has a foreign key relationship to the owner user ensuring data integrity.

This table has a primary stance as users directly create, search, filter, and manage todo items independently within the system.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key identifying the todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The registered user who owns this todo item. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item representing the task summary.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description providing additional information about the todo item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the todo item (e.g., pending, completed, in_progress).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted; null if not deleted.

models.name: todo_app_todo_item_audit_logs
models.description:
Audit logs recording all create, update, and delete actions performed on todo items for security and compliance.

Each log entry captures the specific todo item affected, the user who performed the action, the nature of the action, and timestamps for creation and modification.

This table supports auditing requirements by providing a detailed and immutable trail of all user activities on todo items. It includes soft delete to allow logical deletion while preserving historical data.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the todo item being audited. {@link todo_app_todo_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who performed the action. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of action performed on the todo item (e.g., create, update, delete).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp allowing logical deletion of audit logs while preserving history.
